title_original: 선거관리위원회보안관리대 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <National Election Commission Rule No. 647, February 12, 2026>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on March 1, 2026.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Rules)
(1) The Rules on the Administrative Organization of Election Commissions shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 12 (2), subparagraphs 30 through 35 shall be renumbered as subparagraphs 31 through 36, respectively, and the following new subparagraph 30 shall be inserted:
30. Matters concerning the operation and management of Security Management Units.

(2) The Rules on Public Officials of Election Commissions shall be partially amended as follows:

The following Article 220-2 shall be newly inserted:
Article 220-2 (Designation of Public Officials Engaged in Field Operations, etc.)
(1) The Secretary General may designate as public officials engaged in field operations public officials who, due to the nature of their duties, need to maintain a continuous working system or work normally on Saturdays or public holidays, and may revoke such designation when the necessity ceases to exist.
(2) Matters concerning the working hours, working days, service management and overtime allowances, etc. of public officials engaged in field operations shall be determined by the Secretary General.
